new_items.title: A telomere-to-telomere map of somatic mutation burden and functional impact in a cancer
new_items.summary_rss: A near-telomere-to-telomere diploid assembly is paired with deep long-read sequencing of a matched melanoma, revealing that 16% of somatic variants lie in sequences absent from GRCh38. Satellite repeats absorb UV damage, kinetochore binding domains accrue both genetic and epigenetic variation, and somatic epimutations dominate the altered regulatory landscape.

new_items.title: Arabidopsis uses distinct coumarins and bacterial pathways for pH-adaptive iron acquisition
new_items.summary_rss: Arabidopsis coordinates Fe acquisition with its root microbiota by releasing distinct coumarin chemotypes in response to environmental pH. These root-exuded specialized metabolites interact with root-associated bacteria to mobilize Fe either through bacterial siderophore-dependent chelation at circumneutral pH or through bacterial redox-sensing-controlled reduction at acidic pH.

new_items.title: Cellular scaling laws in the mammalian brain
new_items.summary_rss: This perspective argues that our brains do not operate as a single system; instead, there are two systems, where one is a copy-paste “learning” engine that scales by duplicating the same modules and the other is a bespoke “steering” system that scales by inventing entirely new cell types for every drive and reflex. This split between systems could reshape how we treat addiction and depression and how we build AI.

new_items.title: Charting the silent variation within us
new_items.summary_rss: Every human is a mosaic of trillions of subtly different genomes. This commentary highlights the SMaHT Network’s benchmarking papers and body-wide map of somatic mosaicism and discusses what this newly measurable variation means for development, aging, and disease.

new_items.title: Comprehensive benchmarking of somatic mutation detection by the SMaHT Network
new_items.summary_rss: Benchmarking by the Somatic Mosaicism across Human Tissues Network demonstrates that advances in sequencing and analysis now enable systematic and comprehensive discovery of somatic mutations across diverse mutation types in non-cancerous tissues and across the genome from telomere to telomere.

new_items.title: Immunoregulatory gene GIMAP6 suppresses lethal atherosclerotic vasculopathy and ischemic heart failure
new_items.summary_rss: By destabilizing the endothelium and promoting macrophage lipid loading and inflammation, GIMAP6 deficiency drives atherosclerosis and ischemic heart disease through a mechanism that operates without hyperlipidemia, yet hyperlipidemia significantly exacerbates disease progression.

new_items.title: Milking the niche: Microbial control of neonatal hematopoiesis
new_items.summary_rss: In this issue of Cell, Howard et al. reveal how the milk glycoprotein osteopontin shapes the neonatal microbiome to regulate hematopoiesis, promoting dendritic cell development and protection from severe respiratory infection. These findings uncover a maternal milk-microbiota pathway linking early-life nutrition to immune development and long-term disease susceptibility.

new_items.title: STING reprogramming by estrogen promotes neutrophil extracellular trap formation and sex-biased resistance to ADC therapy
new_items.summary_rss: Sex differences in antibody-based cancer therapy remain poorly understood. This study identifies estrogen-driven STING reprogramming and neutrophil extracellular trap formation as a mechanism of functional antigen shielding that limits ADC efficacy.

new_items.title: Somatic epimutations cap genetic determinism in the human diploid chromatin epigenome
new_items.summary_rss: FIRE is a long-read Fiber-seq method that resolves chromatin accessibility along individual DNA molecules on each parental chromosome, enabling a comprehensive assessment of the diploid epigenome. FIRE reveals that the HLA locus harbors the densest haplotype-selective chromatin in immune cells and resolves regulatory principles of escape from X inactivation. It also uncovers pervasive somatic epimutations, mitotically stable and non-genetically mediated chromatin changes that cap genetic determinism in the human epigenome.

new_items.title: Spatiotemporal co-transcriptomics uncovers coordinated rhizobia-legume stress programs supporting nitrogen fixation in Medicago
new_items.summary_rss: Rhizobial nitrogen fixation in legume nodules requires precise spatial and temporal coordination between plant and bacterial gene expression. This study generates a host-rhizobium co-transcriptomic atlas of Medicago nodulation and reveals stress signaling as an integral component of mutualistic symbiosis.
